title: Oath of Kraków vs Martyrs' Legion
lede:
The Martyrs' Legion won 35-16 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4, scoring 17 VP in that round with all three objectives, LEAD FROM THE FRONT, TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY and OMNIPRESENCE.

The Archistrategos with the Knight-Apostle Squad and the Golgothic Paladins took the centre in Round 2 and destroyed three Oath units there without losing a hit point, while Oath's damage went almost entirely into Covenant Levies worth 10 RP each.
result_line: Martyrs' Legion win 35-16 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). Oath of Kraków set up on rows 12 and 13 in front of its HQ at (7,13): Commonwealth Fusiliers 3 at (3,12), the Rotmistrz leading Consecrated Hussars 1 at (4,12), Tadeusz Kosciuszko leading the Silesian Hammerguards at (5,12), Commonwealth Fusiliers 2 at (6,12), Commonwealth Fusiliers 1 at (9,12) and Consecrated Hussars 2 at (11,13). The Martyrs' Legion set up on row 2 in front of its HQ at (7,1): the Staurotheke War-Shrine at (3,2), Covenant Levies 2 at (4,2), the Archistrategos leading the Knight-Apostle Squad at (6,2), Covenant Levies 3 at (7,2), the Cantor-Preceptor leading Covenant Levies 1 at (9,2), Covenant Levies 4 at (10,2) and the Golgothic Paladins at (11,2). Oath had Priority (fewer units, 9 to 10). It had fewer units, eight besides the HQ, with three 12 RP Fusilier squads and two Hussar squads as its fast pieces, against a Legion built around 155 RP of melee elite (the Archistrategos, the Knight-Apostles, the Paladins) screened by four 10 RP Levy squads.

1.title: Oath take the centre and the left

feed.text: Primaries revealed: IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS for Oath of Kraków, LEAD FROM THE FRONT for the Martyrs' Legion. Secondaries kept: TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (the Legion picked the centre for it) and BAR THE GATES. Oath spent 1 CP on Double Time for the Silesian Hammerguards, which bought nothing; the Legion kept its 3.

Kosciuszko and the Hammerguards advanced 5,12 to 6,7, onto the centre. The Rotmistrz and Consecrated Hussars 1 went to 3,7 and Commonwealth Fusiliers 3 to 2,8 on the left; Consecrated Hussars 2 to 11,8 and Commonwealth Fusiliers 1 to 11,9 on the right. The Legion came up to rows 5 and 6: the Golgothic Paladins to 8,6, the Knight-Apostle Squad and the Archistrategos to 8,5, three Levy squads on row 5 and the War-Shrine to 3,5.

One attack all round: the Knight-Apostle Squad's Relic Pistols with the Miracle PROVIDENCE (TAXIARCH OF MIRACLES kept it unspent) did 4 to the Hammerguards through Kosciuszko, two models. PRAYING gave Oath 8 Mana and the Legion 13.
Oath held the centre on OC 19 vs 6 (3 VP) and the left on 10 vs 0 (2), and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET paid 3. BAR THE GATES paid the Legion 2, no Oath unit being in its half. 8-2.

2.title: The Knight-Apostles and the Paladins take the centre

feed.text: The Legion spent 5 CP: Troop Requisition (3) placed a fifth Covenant Levies at 6,2 and Double Time (2) went to Covenant Levies 1. Oath spent nothing. New secondaries: TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY and OMNIPRESENCE.

The Rotmistrz used Choose the Moment on the War-Shrine and Consecrated Hussars 1 charged it at 2,6: Lance of God's Wrath did 3 and the War-Shrine passed the Winged Terror Morale Test, then broke away to 3,3 on a 6. Consecrated Hussars 2 moved onto the edge of the centre at 7,8 and Go to Ground (1 CP) covered it from Covenant Levies 3's Overwatch, which had PROVIDENCE: 8 hits, all saved. Covenant Levies 1 and 2 went west to 4,5 and 4,4, Covenant Levies 4 to 12,6 by the right objective. After Oath had passed, the Knight-Apostle Squad and the Archistrategos charged Kosciuszko and the Hammerguards at 7,6, and the Golgothic Paladins charged Consecrated Hussars 2 and Commonwealth Fusiliers 2 at 8,8.

The Archistrategos used Quis ut Deus? (+2 FR and AR, +2 DMG, LETHAL) with the Miracle EXALTATION: 5 hits and 2 damage, and the counterattacks of Kosciuszko and the Hammerguards did nothing. The Knight-Apostle Squad did the last 4: Silesian Hammerguards destroyed, 40 RP. Commonwealth Fusiliers 2 attacked the Paladins and their counterattack did all 10 of its HP: Commonwealth Fusiliers 2 destroyed. On the right Commonwealth Fusiliers 1 and Covenant Levies 4 traded 4 each. The Cantor-Preceptor cast Introit (2 Mana) on Covenant Levies 1, which bought nothing.
The Legion took the centre on OC 15 vs 13 (3 VP) and the right on 8 vs 6 (2); Oath kept the left on 14 vs 0 (2). IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid Oath 3, LEAD FROM THE FRONT the Legion 3. 13-10.

3.title: The Hussars kill two Levy squads while the left goes empty

feed.text: The Miracle BENEDICTION healed the War-Shrine 3 HP. Oath spent 5 of its 7 CP: Secure Objective on Commonwealth Fusiliers 1 (3), which bought nothing, and Double Time on Commonwealth Fusiliers 3 (2). The Legion spent none. Secondaries kept: SECURE THE FLANKS and BREAK CONTACT.

Commonwealth Fusiliers 3 used its Double Time to leave the left objective, 2,8 to 6,8 on the edge of the centre. Covenant Levies 3 charged Kosciuszko at 6,6, and Consecrated Hussars 1 with the Rotmistrz charged 2,6 to 5,7 into it and the new Covenant Levies: Lance of God's Wrath's Blast Damage took all ten models of Covenant Levies 3 (3 saves from 30): Covenant Levies 3 destroyed, and 4 off the other squad, which failed Winged Terror and was SUPPRESSED. Consecrated Hussars 2 broke away from the Paladins to 4,9; Kosciuszko fell back from the Knight-Apostles to 5,9 and failed his test for 2 True Damage. The Paladins and the Knight-Apostle Squad then charged Commonwealth Fusiliers 3.

The Rotmistrz hit the Covenant Levies five times for 7 and the Hussars' lances did the last 7: Covenant Levies destroyed; RETRIBUTION let it strike before it was removed, for nothing. The Knight-Apostle Squad hit Commonwealth Fusiliers 3 six times: Commonwealth Fusiliers 3 destroyed. The Archistrategos took 2 off Consecrated Hussars 1, and neither the Hussars nor the Rotmistrz could strike back: the Paladins' Sacred Stigmata protected him. Fusiliers 1 and Covenant Levies 4 traded 2 each; the Cantor-Preceptor cast Introit (2 Mana) on the HQ. The two Levy deaths gave the Legion 2 Martyred Blood.
The Legion held the centre on OC 15 vs 0 and the right on 7 vs 6, Secure Objective or not (5 VP). Nobody held the left. IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS 2, LEAD FROM THE FRONT 3. 15-18.

4.title: Kosciuszko falls on the left; the Legion hold all three

feed.text: Oath spent 1 CP on Double Time for Kosciuszko; the Legion spent 5 on Troop Requisition (a Covenant Levies at 7,2) and Double Time for it. Secondaries kept: DEEP REACH and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY.

Kosciuszko fell back from the Knight-Apostles to the left objective at 1,7, failed the test again (3 True Damage) and took 2 from Covenant Levies 2's Overwatch: 1 HP left. Consecrated Hussars 1 broke away to 3,9, Consecrated Hussars 2 rode 4,9 to 5,5 into the Legion's half, and Commonwealth Fusiliers 1 left the right objective for 10,8. Covenant Levies 2 and the War-Shrine charged Kosciuszko; the Paladins and the Knight-Apostles charged Consecrated Hussars 2 from 5,6 and 4,6; Covenant Levies 1 and the Cantor-Preceptor walked onto the centre at 6,7.

Consecrated Hussars 2 attacked the Paladins and their counterattack did 8, two models. Covenant Levies 2 rolled five hits on Kosciuszko: Tadeusz Kosciuszko destroyed, 65 RP, and the Levies took ground onto 1,7; Oath spent 2 CP on Rally Cry for Consecrated Hussars 1. Covenant Levies 4 hit Commonwealth Fusiliers 1 six times: Commonwealth Fusiliers 1 destroyed. The Introit on the War-Shrine (2 Mana) bought nothing.

The Legion held the centre on OC 11 vs 0, the left on 12 vs 0 and the right on 6 vs 0 (7 VP); LEAD FROM THE FRONT 3, TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY +3, OMNIPRESENCE +4. IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid Oath 1. 16-35, the Legion past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

The Martyrs' Legion scored 17 VP from objectives, 9 from LEAD FROM THE FRONT (3 in each of Rounds 2 to 4) and 9 from secondaries (BAR THE GATES 2, OMNIPRESENCE 4, TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY 3). Oath of Kraków scored 7 from objectives, all in Rounds 1 and 2, 6 from IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS and 3 from TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET. Its Primary paid 1 VP for every 2 units outside its deployment zone that were neither Below Half-Strength nor SUPPRESSED, so it fell from 3 to 2 to 1 as the army died. TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY needed more objectives than the Legion, which Oath never had after keeping the card in Round 2; SECURE THE FLANKS needed a unit in the Legion's half within 2 squares of a side edge, and none went there; DEEP REACH needed an objective held at the end of Round 4, and Kosciuszko died on the left one.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The Knight-Apostle Squad (18 damage, the Silesian Hammerguards and Commonwealth Fusiliers 3) and the Golgothic Paladins (18 damage, Commonwealth Fusiliers 2) won every fight in the centre, and with the Archistrategos they ended the battle at full HP. Nothing Oath threw at them landed: one Hammerguard hit, pistol shots saved, a lance that missed, and in Rounds 3 and 4 no counterattack at all, since Sacred Stigmata keeps enemy attacks off a unit beside the Paladins. The Archistrategos and the Knight-Apostles scored 5.0 VP each, mostly LEAD FROM THE FRONT. The best value was Covenant Levies 4, 8.3 VP for 10 RP (82.7 per 100 RP): the right objective from Round 2 to the end, 10 damage and the Commonwealth Fusiliers 1 kill.

For Oath, Consecrated Hussars 1 did 36 damage, the most on the table, and killed two Levy squads, one of them with Lance of God's Wrath alone. That was 20 RP of a 246 RP army, and each death paid the Legion Martyred Blood; the Legion bought two more Levies with Troop Requisition. Tadeusz Kosciuszko, at 65 RP, scored 4.0 VP and did no damage.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

What Oath could not do

It could not damage the units that held the centre, and it could not afford to trade with them: Oath lost 141 RP (Kosciuszko, the Hammerguards, all three Fusilier squads) to the Legion's 20. Its only damage came from the Hussars and Fusiliers against Levies; the 155 RP of Legion elite took none. Once the centre went in Round 2, Oath had the left alone, and in Round 3 it gave that up too.

{{chart:attrition}}

The AI, not the army

  • Round 3, the left objective: Oath moved both its units off (1,7). Commonwealth Fusiliers 3 spent a 2 CP Double Time to walk 2,8 to 6,8, into charge range of the Knight-Apostles and the Paladins, and died there; Consecrated Hussars 1 charged east to 5,7. The left scored for nobody in Round 3 and for the Legion in Round 4.
  • Round 3, Secure Objective on Commonwealth Fusiliers 1 (3 CP) still lost the right 7 vs 6 and bought nothing.
  • Round 4, Kosciuszko used a Double Time to fall back onto the left objective beside Covenant Levies 2 and the War-Shrine with 6 HP, failed the test and was killed there. The Fall Back record rates it sound (9.39 expected melee damage if he stayed), but the square it chose was no safer.
  • Round 4, Consecrated Hussars 2 rode into the Legion's half at 5,5, next to the Paladins and the Knight-Apostles, and lost two of its three models; Commonwealth Fusiliers 1 walked off the right objective the same round.
  • Oath banked 15 Mana from PRAYING and had no caster to spend it. The Legion's three Introits (6 Mana) bought something once.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated by the AI's charge-planning probes: six of its nine "stayed" entries are not decisions. Round 2 Silesian Hammerguards ("held to the end": the Knight-Apostles charged after Oath had passed its Movement Phase, and the Golgothic Paladins it lists were never adjacent), all three Round 3 "risky holds" (Covenant Levies 1, Covenant Levies 2, the War-Shrine; Consecrated Hussars 1 never reached them) and Round 4 Covenant Levies 4 and the Paladins (Commonwealth Fusiliers 1 never adjacent).

This one looks like the armies more than the AI. Oath's AI made it worse by emptying the left in Round 3, but an army whose damage cannot reach the enemy's objective holders, and which loses a unit every time it contests them, had no line to 30 VP.

closing: The Martyrs' Legion's elite walked into the centre in Round 2 and never left or lost a hit point. Oath of Kraków's Hussars killed what they could reach, which was cheap Levies, while the Legion's Primary and objectives ran to 35 in four rounds.
